notes.title: Public Playtesting - Version 1.112
notes.notes:
Hey Doomed Souls,




My developer minions have been working on my crypts. They want some test subjects to go through first to iron out any bugs that may appear. If you want to join in this new build you only need to follow these simple steps. Well simple for me but for souls like you it might be a challenge.
[olist]
Right click Cryptmaster in your Steam library and click properties 

Go into the Beta Tab and in the drop down menu next to “Beta Participation” select public_testing

Steam should automatically download the new build
[/olist]


If you do run into any issues while playing this build, please go tell the rats in the Steam forums and report your issues. The developer minions will take notes of the issues and continue to “improve” my game. We all know my game was perfect until the developers got involved.



Here are the patch notes that the developer minions want to pass on. 

Fixed damage based on cards returning wrong value (it doesn't currently count card finished)

Improved ispy island, so if you revisit it, the script fires a bit easier.

Hand sizes and tab sizes now will have a max size (8 and 26 respectively).

The player UI for cards will offset when over 5 cards to make additional space.

Headbutler card renamed to topbutler.

Rewrote two of the new crop of gravestones as they had conflicting names

Removed duplicate gravestone spawning appears on one of the maps.

Reduced riddle skeleton card difficulty by reducing his pair detection, as it was a little high.

Fixed the auto bypass of the Pixie court Whatever quest

Fixed 7k resolution not correctly being picked up, is was reverting to lowest res on some machines

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Hey doomed souls,

It has been a bit since I’ve had the unfortunate and undesirable moment to talk with you. Yes, I liked it better when you were trapped in my crypts, screaming trying to get out. The good news is: there will be more of that in the future! My dungeon will be getting an expansion. My developer minions have been toiling their poor souls to death trying to get me to free them. 

They have updated and expanded on the irresistible card game of Whatever, in which I am undefeated. Anyone that tells you otherwise is lying and will be dealt with promptly. Now, my thrall will explain how to play and what is new in the taverns.

[previewyoutube=476Z1kBUp5A;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, it is the Cryptmaster's favorite minion! One day they will remember my name!

Whatever, as some of you may know, is the premiere card-word game down in the underworld. Please don’t tell the people in the overworld or they might try to monetize it and turn it into loot boxes or throw a battlepass on there. They can get very scary up there.

Anywho, throughout your adventures you can challenge people to a game of Whatever by asking them “Whatever.” Only the lowest life would refuse to play against you.

Once you draw your letter tabs, you will also draw cards that have powerful effects to help you win the game. Before you start the game you can swap tabs or cards that you have drawn to gain a better start.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718540/95276d0a00edc11b3fe789c664d404e3519914cb.jpg

After you begin, you will start first. Player luck or something. You and your opponent will start with 40 life and your goal is to eliminate their life before they have a chance to terminate yours. You’ll deal damage with cards by selecting two letter tabs to play at a time, trying to match letters to the names of the cards in your hand. In addition to the effect of the card itself, each letter you match deals 1 damage. Once you play your letter tabs your turn ends. Your turn will start again once the opponent's turn completes. 

The cards in your deck are very important. If you spell the words on the card they may unleash powerful effects! They can range from healing, dealing damage, increasing hand size, and more. That effect will play after your letter damage and you will draw a new card. In between matches, you will gain new cards to play with, especially by winning games of Whatever. In between games, you can set up your deck and choose the cards you want to play. What deck will you build?

You may have noticed the black letter tabs in the screenshot. The black tabs are wild letters that will change letters every turn. White tabs won’t change letters. Wild letters can help you seal the deal! Especially when they change into something powerful for you!

If you only have terrible tabs and there is no good play, then you can use your turn to turn in all your letters and draw all new tabs. You won’t do any damage and won’t gain progress on your cards but you could set up for a powerful play your next turn.

Anniversary Update
The wonderful, infallible Cryptmaster ordered us to expand on the perfect crypts and so, we’ll be featuring plenty of new gameplay to dig into. They deserve all the credit. Don’t listen to the developers trying to take their credit.

New NPCs to meet! Yes! Yes! They are friendly, I promise! They just want to play Whatever! The Highwayman & The Innkeeper! Go meet them!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718540/ae8f1e16829592e0043877a9834727c8728923f9.jpg

Downwood also got an expansion. There are rumors of a new graveyard in Downwood as… I’m too scared of the paranormal to look! Please don’t make me go! The Tavern where you can play in Whatever tournaments against new players. Defeat them all and gain new cards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718540/e4fff50fba84a0783a192aa3d95ccee9c5eebf8e.jpg

Speaking of new cards, this update adds a few new cards. 10? No. 20? Think higher! 50? Higher! Over 100 new cards! So many new cards! New combos and strategies to develop! Don’t drop them! It might take a while to clean them up.

If Whatever just wasn’t your cup of whatever you drink, then there are a few other things that might be enticing to check out. There is a new enemy to find. The Piskies. I personally stay away from them as they are too dangerous for a lower minion like me to fight so I don’t have much information on them but I’m sure strong heroes like you will do fine!

There is a new world map feature in the dungeon! If you press “5” the map will expand to show you what area you are in on the map! Very helpful in figuring out where you may need to go! I suggested “You are Here” signs throughout the dungeon but the Cryptmaster knows best!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718540/f810594da4331006c760878cdfecb9a17afab790.jpg

Some other important feature that the Crypmaster blessed us with is that the crypts now have 7k support and a new auto color option! This will change the color tints based on the location you are in!

That is all I have for now! Be sure to check out the new stuff!

Thank you for keeping that minion busy. If I had a brain he would have given me a headache many years ago. For keeping him distracted and giving me a few minutes of peace and quiet, I am pushing this update now and for free! See, I can be nice sometimes. Hahaha...

- The Cryptmaster

notes.title: Patch notes v1.04.1
notes.notes:
Hey doomed souls,

I’m sorry about the sounds of construction in the crypts while working on this patch. Of course you don’t have ears, they rotted away many decades ago heheh. This patch includes Steamdeck specific fixes to the joypad system, options toggle to disable eating sounds, new procedural text system for joypad input and more. 

Full Patch Notes

 New predictive text system for joypad input, expanding the virtual joypad to auto detect skills, words and alike to make for much easier word entry, contextual based on situation.
 Steamdeck specific fixes to the joypad system, including fixing input lag and improvements to virtual joypad navigation.
 Removal of the old predictive system (sorry speedrunners!) as it conflicts with the new predictive joypad system, this will be further revised in the next update.
 Spanish rare fish names are not correctly named.
 More fixes to Iss's scroll to make it a little bit more easy.
 Options toggle to disable eating sounds.
 Ratty's node on the map is obscured has been fixed.
 Steamdeck support for upscaling minimap text to be more readable.
 fixing the Goggo achievement to allow 100% completion.
 5120x1440 ultrawide support.

Also we are less than 50 reviews to 1,000 reviews on Steam with an overwhelming positive rating! Thank you for the amazing support for the best crypts on Steam!

- The Cryptmaster

notes.title: Patch notes v1.0.35
notes.notes:
Hey doomed souls,

It seems my developer minions have worked on a new patch and have released it from right under my nose. I can’t believe that with hundreds of thousands of possibilities for souls to go through my crypts that the developer minions would miss a few bugs. I might need to take away their five minutes of fresh air a week as punishment. 

Here are the full patch notes.

 Spanish Language: When you talk to the rat "Steven" before you meet the king and say "papa", Steven responds in English instead of Spanish
 Spanish Language: Added additional Spanish VO
 Respawning chest in bonehouses
 Added more specific Ratty instructions.
 Added achievement unlock square with the secret word in the temple.
 Added Skip function on skill level-ups via space/trigger.
 Added Steamdeck resolution bumps on fonts to make them more readable.
 Added Local saving of resolution and some display settings so if you swap machines it doesn't inherit cloud saves for those values.
 Added additional Cryptmaster quips post-Goggo sleep and Vitus rap.
 Fixed gods not reacting to cards on the second conversation
 Fixed Agdas lipsync breaks on the new altar in the swamps.
 Fixed Goggo not recognizing "whatever" on the first try, only the second try and beyond.
 Fixed play functionality to some of the chest items.
 Fixed baseline finger upgrades that automatically happen in addition to being able to modify them via options, 1 for crypts, 2 for bonehouses, and 3 fingers for sunken sea minimums.
 Updated lantern particles to medium minimum to display, to help with fps loss on slower systems/steamdeck.
 Audo on the second visit will now have an alternate shorter script.
 Edited God scrolls to be slightly more simplified.


- The Cryptmaster

notes.title: The Crypts 1.034 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey doomed souls,

It seems that some of you have discovered some bugs in my perfect crypts– and not the kind whose soul you slurp up. I would like personally to apologize to those who had to listen to Finks laugh and not being able to skip it, attacks not doing the correct damage, and a few more issues the visitors have found. My goal is to make the crypts as welcoming as possible so that more souls can become trapped and try to escape. I will personally take away a few letters from my minions. 

Before I finish, Cryptmaster has almost 500 reviews on Steam with a 96% positive rating. If we keep above 95% at 500 reviews, my unholy crusade will be upgraded to “overwhelmingly positive” on Steam so if you have some time, please leave us a review.
 
Now back to the patch notes, here is the full notes

 Additional looting "Fingers" on enemies' letters accessibility toggle for quicker skill unlocks.
 Reducing the difficulty on god scrolls
 Stopped Vitus rap looping from the start when you want to enter something else.
 Disable screenshake option in menu
 Tomb kings hold subtitles added, so the subtitles don't fade away.
 Additional fishing tooltips on first cast
 To palace to change to palace/swamps, and or generally better swamp markers.
 Gel cube area named as location, removing a bit of swamp confusion
 Lorias door still glitches out sometimes, will rebuild that script.
 Swamps altar, between the palace and the pools to add another save point
 Add block minimap rotation option in options
 Ratty respawning even if quest is complete
 Temple audio upgrades on the speaker system.
 [spoiler]Embezzle[/spoiler] - deal 1 damage when it mentions 2 damage
 [spoiler]Dogwhistle[/spoiler] - damage fixed.
 Goggos script dead ends and blocks progress after you revisit him post Pantry.
 Bump zombie names at top of tower, increasing difficulty slightly.
 [spoiler]N and M[/spoiler] skulls are too close together, they will be moving further apart.
 Add controller real-time slowdown, so real-time is a bit more forgiving on controller.
 The icon on the map where you entered so that you can see your map entry point.
 New level-up music and world music.
 Self-damage in cards plays wrong sound effects
 Rare fish are a bit too skittish right now
 Finks laughs variation, also fix it so it is skippable.
 Double [spoiler]Darkness[/spoiler] skull in the Bonehouses
 Highlight on whatever on start sometimes missing
 Removed RNG on shields + armor combinations so you cant get damage locked.
 Slow down [spoiler]murder/drums[/spoiler] cooldown, so you can preempt those out of combat.
 [spoiler]Urchins[/spoiler] gets buffed to 4 projectiles.
 Fish highlighting white between maps
 Library east wing/right labels
 Iss shader toned back
 Remove line breaking on danger letters entirely, so that it doesn't break on Iss's island.
 Eyestone card is bugged, will be renamed to "Eye" also.
 Pipers final rap has wrong lines on final/repeat version.
 Joros self damage abilities will be buffed to allow for more variety in his use.
 Payns boulders not activating if you go the long way.
 Moving one of the dead paladins in the downwood to a more central location, making a generic mob you get the helmet from, the other will be either a dead body, or a mob, depending on which you kill first, this will lead into the update beyond 1.034....
 Spanish news puzzle has been correctly realigned on the levels to represent N O S E instead of N O E S
 Riddle04 despawning bug fixed.
 Fixed combat lock when fighting gel cubes in the swamps


If you want to check out the change logs for the next patch, one of my developer minions have started a post here so you can view what is coming next.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1885110/discussions/0/4337608365463568669/ 

- The Cryptmaster

notes.title: Demo Patch v1.0.12
notes.notes:
Hey doomed souls,

My full crypts are almost complete. On May 9th, your souls will face off against the full force of rats, toad men, and other disgusting pests that hide in the darkest corners of the dungeon. For now though, my minions have updated the demo to increase word detection, full controller support, adding Spanish and more. I may increase their yearly sunlight time from 3 seconds to 4 seconds as a reward. Aren’t I so thoughtful? Here are the full patch notes from the dev minions.

Patch Notes

 Added the Spanish Language
 Added full controller support
 Added Increased word detection from the Cryptmaster
 Added new chests
 Added full credits
 Added randomly placed chests
 Fixed enemy AI and pathing
 Fixed audio balance options in the menu
 Fixed voice detection to be more accurate

- The Cryptmaster

notes.title: Typing dungeon crawler Cryptmaster announces release date during IGF award acceptance speech
notes.notes:
In a powerful move, one of the two devs behind Cryptmaster announced the delightful typing-based dungeon crawler's release date last night during his acceptance speech after it won the Independent Games Festival award for Excellence In Design. Powerful. May 9th is the day, so you have time to practise your touchtyping with Mavis Beacon. I really enjoyed playing Cryptmaster's Steam Next Fest demo, so I'm excited for the full game.
